overall.verdict: A genuinely premium dark product with a novel, honest risk model (one absolute bar scale, enforceable vs promised) — the core pay/receive/activity path is excellent. Trust and first-timer onboarding are undercut by dense jargon (credit room, lines out, bilateral-signed) and by two screens that read as dev or placeholder (Assets faucets, Lending's 100% per term), so it is strong for an expert but not yet a 3-minute story for a skeptic.
priority_fixes: Define or replace the core jargon in the payment path ('up to 175.00 instantly', 'credit room', 'lines out', 'bilateral-signed') with one plain sentence each — helps Maya, Sofia, Fatima, Dmitri
Fix the Lending screen's '100bps = 100% per term' and the disabled-looking Offer button: show an annualized APR and an enabled-state with an inline reason — the single biggest trust-killer
Compress the Assets screen's testnet Faucets block and replace the 100%/0% collateral slider with a plain 'if H1 defaults you lose $X' line — helps Anya, Ravi
Rework the Desk lane table (and define 'lines out') and merge the duplicate stat cards — reduces density for Marcus and any non-operator
Add an explicit invoice/Request flow and copy affordances on proof hashes — Sofia needs an invoice, not just a payment link; Ravi needs a clean, copyable proof
